story.skyabyss.opening.p1: Long ago, the sky and the earth kept a promise.
story.skyabyss.opening.p2: In the sky flew an old thing that dragged the moon behind it.
story.skyabyss.opening.p3: Deep under the earth beat a heart that held the world in place.
story.skyabyss.opening.p4: The heart split its beat in four and gave it to the titans.
story.skyabyss.opening.p5: The titans sang, and kept the moon away. People built towns upon their backs.
story.skyabyss.opening.p6: On the ground, the Skywatch family rang their bell and watched the sky.
story.skyabyss.opening.p7: ...No one rings the bell now. And the moon is drawing near again.
story.skyabyss.opening.p8: On a nameless island, a traveller wakes.
story.skyabyss.opening.p9: "Write it down before you forget. So that next time, you notice sooner."
